question: Compare how many support tickets APAC and EMEA customers opened in 2025. If APAC opened more than 1.5 times as many as EMEA, break APAC's 2025 tickets down by month (label months as YYYY-MM); otherwise, break both regions' 2025 tickets down by severity.

sql_attempts.sql: WITH region_tickets AS (SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(t.ticket_id) AS ticket_count FROM support_tickets AS t JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE t.created_date >= '2025-01-01' AND t.created_date <= '2025-12-31' AND r.region_name IN ('APAC', 'EMEA') GROUP BY r.region_name), apac_count AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT ticket_count FROM region_tickets WHERE region_name = 'APAC'), 0) AS cnt), emea_count AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT ticket_count FROM region_tickets WHERE region_name = 'EMEA'), 0) AS cnt) SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', t.created_date) AS breakdown_key, COUNT(t.ticket_id) AS ticket_count FROM support_tickets AS t JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE r.region_name = 'APAC' AND t.created_date >= '2025-01-01' AND t.created_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (SELECT cnt FROM apac_count) > 1.5 * (SELECT cnt FROM emea_count) GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y-%m', t.created_date) UNION ALL SELECT t.severity AS breakdown_key, COUNT(t.ticket_id) AS ticket_count FROM support_tickets AS t JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE r.region_name IN ('APAC', 'EMEA') AND t.created_date >= '2025-01-01' AND t.created_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (SELECT cnt FROM apac_count) <= 1.5 * (SELECT cnt FROM emea_count) GROUP BY t.severity LIMIT 500
